The loaf is oblong with rounded ends, covered in a thick, glossy red glaze (likely ketchup or tomato sauce). There is a lighter, yellowish patch on the right side of the surface where the glaze may be thinner or broken. The background shows a dark countertop and a hint of an orange wall.
